title: dedicated: implement autoscaling burst controls and utilization reporting for GPU pools
author: Anika Rao
description: Motivation: Dedicated GPU pools need predictable throughput but also the ability to absorb short-term spikes without violating long-tail latency SLOs. This PR implements a burst controller that enforces burst budgets per-pool and a utilization reporter that feeds fleet-level dashboards and autoscaler heuristics. Summary of changes: 1) burst controller component that tracks per-pool burst credits, enforces hard and soft burst ceilings, and exposes actions for graceful degradation (route to warm standby models, reject with retry-after, or scale-out request). 2) telemetry pipeline additions: pool_utilization_reporter (Go) emits 1m/5m utilization, spike detection tags, and budget consumption metrics. 3) Autoscaler integration: autoscaler now consults burst budget before deciding scale-out and emits proposed vs applied scale decisions to aid post-hoc analysis. 4) New e2e tests and unit tests covering budget accounting, race conditions during concurrent allocation, and metrics emission. Backwards compatibility: default behavior preserves existing autoscaler decisions when burst budgets are disabled (feature-flag off). Rollout plan: staged feature-flag rollout to 10% of Dedicated customers, monitor metrics/alerts (slo/budget_exhaustion/errors), then increase to 100% if no regressions. Checklist: [x] Design doc linked ENG-4821 [x] Unit tests added [x] Integration tests added [x] Docs updated in redwood-docs (dedicated/autoscaling) [x] Telemetry dashboards updated. Testing and results: synthetic stress tests show 18-22% reduction in tail P95 token latency for bursty traffic patterns at equivalent cost compared to previous naive scale-out, and budget enforcement prevented runaway scale events in an incident repro. See performance_summary field for numbers. See related work: ENG-4720 (initial autoscaler refactor), ENG-4518 (kv cache pressure mitigation).

release_notes: Introduce burst budget enforcement and utilization reporting for Dedicated GPU pools. Adds configuration for burst budgets, new telemetry for pool utilization, and safer autoscaler behavior to prevent runaway scale events. Rollout behind feature flag.
performance_summary: Synthetic benchmark: 18-22% reduction in P95 token latency under bursty load patterns vs pre-change autoscaler. Cost delta: ~+2% during heavy sustained load, -8% over mixed traffic due to reduced unnecessary scale-outs. Budget exhaustion protected against >3x scale amplification seen in incident repro.
